saw_lines: Buyers of abrasives pick by grit, size and the machine they own, then reorder the same disc until it wears out.
So the sale is won in the ad, where a buyer with a size in mind needs a reason to click.
Your 4 live Meta ads carry no proof number, so collect one review count or orders shipped and lead every ad with it.
ads_1: Product-led ads opening on grit, size and machine fit, one per common machine
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
